{
  "purpose": "UI design/implementation handover and detailed analysis request.",
  "observations": [
    {
      "id": "E1/header",
      "region": "[0, 0, 1000, 140]",
      "visibleText": ["10:23", "예약"],
      "description": "OS status bar (top left) and app header. Header contains a left-pointing chevron icon (back navigation) and the centered title '예약' (Reservation). White background.",
      "box": [0, 0, 1000, 140]
    },
    {
      "id": "E2/section-title",
      "region": "[0, 240, 1000, 290]",
      "visibleText": ["결제 수단"],
      "description": "Section header text '결제 수단' (Payment Method). Bold, dark grey text on white background.",
      "box": [0, 240, 1000, 290]
    },
    {
      "id": "E3/payment-grid",
      "region": "[0, 310, 1000, 500]",
      "visibleText": ["pay", "tosspay", "신용/체크 카드", "콕계좌이체", "N pay", "PAYCO", "법인 카드", "휴대폰 결제", "간편 계좌이체"],
      "description": "3x3 grid of payment method buttons. The top-left button is selected (light blue background, yellow 'pay' logo). Other buttons are white with grey borders and logos/text.",

    },
    {
      "id": "E4/checkbox-save",
      "region": "[0, 510, 1000, 560]",
      "visibleText": ["이 결제 수단을 다음에도 사용"],
      "description": "Checkbox with a blue checkmark, followed by text '이 결제 수단을 다음에도 사용' (Use this payment method next time).",
      "box": [0, 510, 1000, 560]
    },
    {
      "id": "E5/section-agreement",
      "region": "[0, 600, 1000, 800]",
      "visibleText": ["전체 동의", "렌터카 이용 및 취소/환불규정 동의 (필수)", "개인정보 수집 및 이용 동의 (필수)", "개인정보 제3자 제공 동의 (필수)"],
      "description": "Agreement section. Includes a '전체 동의' (Agree to all) checkbox (checked), followed by a list of three mandatory agreement items, each with a checkbox (all checked) and a chevron icon.",
      "box": [0, 600, 1000, 800]
    },
    {
      "id": "E6/cta-button",
      "region": "[0, 820, 1000, 890]",
      "visibleText": ["10,057원 결제하기"],
      "description": "Full-width primary action button. Blue background, white text '10,057원 결제하기' (Pay 10,057 won).",
      "box": [0, 820, 1000, 890]
    },
    {
      "id": "E7/footer",
      "region": "[0, 900, 1000, 950]",
      "visibleText": ["(주)여기어때컴퍼니는...", "상품의 예약, 이용 및 환불 등과 관련된 의무와 책임은 각 판매자에게 있습니다."],
      "description": "Footer legal text in small, light grey font. Contains company name and liability disclaimer.",
      "box": [0, 900, 1000, 950]
    },
    {
      "id": "E8/selected-payment",
      "region": "[0, 310, 333, 370]",
      "visibleText": ["pay"],
      "description": "The specific 'pay' button in the grid. It has a light blue background and a yellow logo, indicating the active selection state.",
      "box": [0, 310, 333, 370]
    }
  ],
  "relations": [
    "E1 is the parent container for the header.",
    "E2 is a sibling to the E3 grid, acting as its label.",
    "E3 is a grid of 9 items; E8 is the selected item within this grid.",
    "E4 is a sibling to E3, positioned below it.",
    "E5 is a sibling to E4, positioned below it.",
    "E6 is a sibling to E5, positioned below it.",
    "E7 is a sibling to E6, positioned below it."
  ],
  "unknowns": [
    "Exact CSS font-family and font-size.",
    "Exact CSS padding and margin values.",
    "Exact HEX color codes.",
    "Border radius values.",
    "Touch target sizes.",
    "Interaction states (hover, focus, pressed).",
    "Off-screen content."
  ]
